description: 后对f兵 — 平局陷阱：黑王躲入角落，永续将

intro.popup_en: Warning: a draw trap. With an f-pawn and the black king driven into the corner, the position may be drawn by perpetual check. See why White can be unable to make progress.
intro.popup:
⚠️ 警告！平局陷阱！
f兵+黑王向角落跑 = 必然平局。
白方无论怎样都会陷入永续将——看清楚为什么！

outro.popup_en: Draw by perpetual check. Once the black king reaches the h1 corner, the queen cannot both give check and stop promotion. Remember: an f-pawn with the king trapped in the corner can be a draw.
outro.popup:
🤝 平局！永续将。
关键：黑王进入h1角后，后无法既将军又阻升变，陷入死局。
记住：f兵角落 = 平局！

moves.popup_en: White tries to drive the black king away with check.
The black king slips into the corner. This is the critical defensive move and White's problem begins.
moves.popup: ⚡ 黑王钻进角落！这是关键一步——白方的麻烦开始了。

moves.popup_en: White tries to block the promotion route and prevent ...f1=Q.
moves.popup: 白尝试封住升变路——阻止f1升后。

moves.popup_en: The black king moves safely around the board.
White blocks the promotion route again, but the pawn is ready to promote.
moves.popup: 白再次封堵——下步要升变了！

moves.popup_en: The black king returns to the corner. If the queen leaves e2, the pawn can promote.
moves.popup: 黑王回到角落！后若离开e2，兵就升变……

moves.popup_en: Perpetual check! White can make no progress, so the game is drawn.
moves.popup: 🤝 永续将！白方已无法进步——平局成立。
